opencodeSession.shareConfirmBody: opencode will publish this session to its own hosting, where anyone with the link can read it. What goes out is the conversation itself — your prompts, the agent's replies, and the input and output of every tool it ran — together with the absolute path of the session's working directory. Nothing is redacted. You can take the page down afterwards with "Revoke the share link", but that cannot un-read anything already read.
